blocker: Resolved by the Tier-1 httpRequest includeInput option. Residual: Tier-2 PATCH conditional support is ifVersion/If-Match (optimistic CAS); concurrent conflicts return 409 and must surface to the user.
requiredEnabler: Engine prior-node context (e.g. $node["Validate"]) or a Tier-2 conditional/merge update contract with tenant/product authz and audit.
widgetActionGap: DX action vocabulary is create|update|delete|execute; these transitions are bound with action=update and workflowRef in the plugin bundles.

invariants: the incident must exist in the caller tenant and be readable by the workflow credential
assigned_to must be a non-empty operator identifier
resolved/closed incidents cannot be reassigned
the assignment notification is a separate Tier-2 notification action, never a silent side effect
resolution_type must be fixed|duplicate|not_an_issue|transferred (default fixed)
an already resolved incident returns the current record without a second write
closed incidents cannot be resolved again
the resolution notification is a separate Tier-2 notification action
completed/cancelled work orders cannot be reassigned
assignee must be a non-empty operator identifier
cannot start a completed or cancelled work order
starting an already in-progress order is idempotent
a work order must be in_progress before completion
completed/cancelled orders cannot be re-completed
the completion notification is a separate Tier-2 notification action

implementation: Implemented with the Tier-1 httpRequest includeInput:true option: GET -> code invariants/merge -> PATCH full data with ifVersion optimistic CAS. Source-ready, inactive until DX binds credentialRef and pins artifacts.

invariants: already acknowledged is idempotent
resolved/closed incidents are not acknowledged
an already closed incident is refused
closing preserves unrelated fields
rejection records not_an_issue and reason
closed incidents are refused
verification is operator-attributed via audit
closed incidents are refused
completed/cancelled work orders are refused
assignment history is preserved

patch.comments: {append entry {id, comment, user_id, user_name, is_internal, posted_at, created_at}}

invariants: the incident must exist and carry a record version
a comment entry is appended; existing comments and unrelated fields are preserved
the comment author is the submitting member identity, never a client-supplied name
the write stays private (publish:false); the City service remains the only publisher
visibility must be internal or public
internal means public_visible:false so the City service never publishes the record to the open-data layer
the write stays private (publish:false); publication remains a City service decision
one upvote per reporter: a submitter already present in upvoters returns an idempotent result without a second write
upvoters entries are reporter identities recorded by the workflow, never client-supplied
the write stays private (publish:false)

patch.merged_reporter_ids: {existing union successfully closed duplicate ids, sorted, deduplicated}

invariants: 1..5 duplicates per merge; a duplicate id equal to the primary is rejected
each duplicate closes with resolution_type:duplicate, merged_into:<primary id> and the shared resolution notes
only duplicates that are actually closed after the writes extend merged_reporter_ids; not-found duplicates are reported as failed and skipped
a CAS conflict on any duplicate close fails the run for an explicit re-run instead of a silent partial merge
every write stays private (publish:false)

patch.preventive_schedule: {cycle_days, cycle_description, warning_days, responsible_team, last_maintenance_date, next_maintenance_date, active}

invariants: cycle_days is an integer between 1 and 3650 (the archived preventive-maintenance range)
next_maintenance_date = last_maintenance_date + cycle_days; last_maintenance_date defaults to the record's completion or scheduled date
the write stays private (publish:false)

patch.records: bulk create one preventive work order per due schedule

invariants: idempotent by a schedule-run marker: a schedule that already produced a preventive order today is skipped
the created order carries schedule_source_id, schedule_run_date and the advanced schedule_next_due so a re-run is a no-op
orders are created through the Tier-2 records bulk API (1..50 per run) with per-entry error reporting
the check writes only work orders; it never edits the schedule source records

patch.attachments: {append entry {file_id, file_name, file_type, kind, size, checksum_sha256, title, description, uploaded_by, uploaded_at}}

invariants: the file must already be stored through the common files capability (DX upload action); the workflow reads its metadata and refuses an unknown file id
only the archived upload MIME allowlist is accepted (4 image + 6 document types); anything else is rejected as unsupported_file_type
the attachment entry is appended to the asset record's attachments array (the archived POST /v1/assets/:id/documents semantics); existing entries are preserved
the write stays private (publish:false); the City service remains the only publisher of asset projections
